what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Malawi, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 25285 of these refugees in Malawi, 2.1% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the country, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996, at war level in many years, and in every year from 2016 to 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the opponents it records include Kamuina Nsapu, RNL, CNPSC and M23, and it also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 27 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 25684, at the end of 2023, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malawi.
These are year-end totals for Malawi only, reported to UNHCR.
